_說明: 範例資料（架構書 §5.4 的梅子農場）。複製到 inputs/brand.json 後，依實際店家、角色與實景照修改。
name: 楠西梅子農場
cta: 私訊訂位｜台南市楠西區

character.anchor_zh: 中年男性農場老闆，圓臉、短黑髮、曬黑膚色，穿綠色格子襯衫與卡其工作褲，頭戴草帽，腰繫深藍圍裙。
character.anchor_en: A friendly middle-aged Taiwanese farm owner with a round face, short black hair and tanned skin, wearing a green plaid shirt, khaki work pants, a straw hat and a dark blue apron

scenes.description_zh: 清晨果園入口，木製招牌與梅樹
scenes.description_en: a plum orchard entrance at dawn with a wooden sign and plum trees

scenes.description_zh: 梅樹下採收區，枝頭掛滿青梅
scenes.description_en: under plum trees heavy with green plums in the harvest area

scenes.description_zh: 農舍前的木桌，擺著梅子醋與山谷景觀
scenes.description_en: a wooden table in front of the farmhouse with bottles of plum vinegar and a valley view

plan.title: 晨光裡的第一口梅子
plan.concept: 老闆角色帶遊客在清晨果園採梅，最後邀請來訂位

shots.action_en: The character turns toward the camera, smiles and waves warmly
shots.subtitle: 早安！梅子熟了喔

shots.action_zh: 角色伸手摘下一顆青梅，拿到鏡頭前展示
shots.action_en: The character reaches up, picks a green plum from the branch and holds it up to show the camera
shots.subtitle: 親手摘，最新鮮
shots.camera: 固定機位，輕微手持晃動
shots.camera_en: static shot with subtle handheld movement

shots.action_zh: 角色舉起一杯梅子醋，向鏡頭招手邀請
shots.action_en: The character raises a glass of plum vinegar and beckons the viewer with an inviting gesture
shots.subtitle: 週末來坐坐吧！
